title.en: An Act Providing for the Cancellation of a Certain standing Indebtedness of the Province of Zamboanga to the Insular Government.

text.en:
The standing indebtedness of the Province of Zamboanga to the Insular Government in the
amount of thirty thousand one hundred and nineteen pesos and sixty-nine centavos which represents the
unpaid balance of the account of said province with the Bureau of Supply on account of rice furnished by the
latter to the Zamboanga Trading Systems during the rice crisis of nineteen hundred and nineteen and nineteen
hundred and twenty, and of supplies furnished by the same Bureau for use in the operation of the motor boat
Colonist which was operated by the said trading systems, is hereby cancelled and the Insular Auditor is
authorized to relieve the Province of Zamboanga from said indebtedness, and to credit the Bureau of Supply
therefor, pursuant to section six hundred and fifty-one of the Administrative Code of nineteen hundred and

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 7, 1931.
